notes.title: Level update
notes.content: The new level has been launched and some changes for game. However, due to lack of testing, there will be some little bugs, but they will be fixed as soon as possible

notes.title: Stage 2 update
notes.content:
The contents added (changed) in this update are as follows:

-Added a backpack system, which allows players to put some props in their pockets instead of holding them in their hands. Use the I key to open the backpack, which can be tested in the tutorial level 

-UI minor changes, which have become clearer 

-Added two diffuse modes for the flashlight 

-Set minor changes, added customization of ray tracing and more subtle adjustments to adapt to more hardware, And the settings will be saved, which does not need to be changed every time 

-[i]RainyNight[/i] level AI small repair, reducing the move bugs

.........

notes.title: Next step plan
notes.content:
Simply and clearly state two sentences:
1. The current project is under slow and very unstable development
2. This game will take the initiative to get off the shelf after a period of time (There is only one reason, that is the quality is too low, and the cost of modifying the underlying code is too large and meaningless)

notes.title: Important update work
notes.content:
According to the data in the past three days of sale, we found a large number of malicious refunds from China (the current version of the game process is about 60 minutes, but most of these people spend more than 60 minutes in game before refunding, so this is "thought-provoking" T n T). It was originally intended to stop sales in China and eliminate the impact, but considering that there are still many honest players, we prepared a major change (extending the game time and fundamentally solving the problem), including but not limited to the improvement of the plot, map update, AI algorithm upgrade, UI remake, and more. so this update work ​will keep more than 20 days.

Thanks to all the players who have been silently supporting this game ^v^

In addition, the following four languages will be added after this update
-French
-Italian
-Russian
-Japanese
